method: a genuine Avito js/items response captured from a residential session on 2026-11-06 (50 hits, 2 with isReserved=true); trimmed to one hit with isReserved=false, one with isReserved=true and a copy of the first with the isReserved key removed (the unknown case), each reduced to the keys the parser reads. De-identified: ids, URLs and titles are fictional, the context query and every seller, phone, image and gallery key are dropped; prices, location and timestamps are as served.

ground_truth.note: availability per hit: active (isReserved=false), reserved (isReserved=true), unknown (no isReserved key); default include_inactive=false keeps 2 items and reports excluded_inactive=1
